paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Modality Distribution
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the modality distribution across seven distinct audio categories in the MMAR benchmark dataset, with each slice representing the proportional representation of a specific audio type. The largest segment, labeled “Speech,” accounts for 29.4% and is depicted in a medium purple hue. Following this, “Mix-Sound-Speech” comprises 21.8% in a lighter lavender shade, while “Music” makes up 20.6% in a similar medium purple tone. “Sound” constitutes 16.5% in a pale lavender. The “Mix-Music-Speech” category represents 8.2% in a darker purple. Smaller segments include “Mix-Sound-Music-Speech” at 2.4% and “Mix-Sound-Music” at 1.1%, both rendered in very light purple and visually separated by thin white dividers. All slices are labeled directly on the chart with their respective percentages, and the chart employs a donut-style layout with a white center, emphasizing the relative proportions of each modality without a separate legend. The segments are arranged in a roughly descending order clockwise from the top-right, visually highlighting the dominance of speech and mixed modalities involving speech.
